enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to back. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Breathe deeply. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering, and personal hygiene
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Urinate. Flush toilet. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Toast bread. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Pick up bag. Pack laptop. Pick up phone. Pick up keys. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Adjust seat. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Turn steering wheel. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Lock car. Walk to hospital.

Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurse station. Pick up clipboard. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Take blood pressure. Listen to heart. Check IV. Administer medication. Record notes. Walk to next patient. Repeat.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Sit at table. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Wipe mouth. Throw trash. Walk back to ward. Pick up fork. Cut food. Chew food. Swallow.

Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Take temperature. Measure blood pressure. Listen to lungs. Administer injection. Change bandage. Update patient record. Walk to nurse station. Consult with doctor. Answer phone. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to patient room. Assist patient with walking. Record notes.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Turn steering wheel. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Lock car. Walk to house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil. Add meat. Cook meat. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Serve food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Wash dishes.

Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Return to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer for leisure or study
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Sit at desk. Open computer. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Open browser. Check email. Open document. Type. Save document. Open game. Play game. Close game. Shut down computer. Stand up. Turn off light. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Urinate. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wash face. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to back. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Breathe deeply. Sleep.
